Products October 28, 2026 LEGO® Friends reveal three new sets at magical Unicorn Café pop-up the LEGO Group unveiled three new LEGO® Friends sets, launching 1 January 2027. Responsibility October 27, 2026 The LEGO Group teams up with Sesame Street to inspire young children to fall in love with nature The LEGO Group and Sesame Workshop, the global nonprofit behind Sesame Street, have launched three new videos, funded by the LEGO Foundation, encouraging children aged 4 to 6 to discover the natural world through play. Featuring Elmo, Cookie Monster and other Sesame Street friends, the videos introduce children to bats, butterflies and worms before inviting them to build habitats using LEGO bricks and everyday craft materials. The LEGO Group’s free activity guides and printables help families and educators extend the experience through hands-on play at home and in community settings.

Products October 15, 2026 Ciao, Venice: The LEGO Group floats new Icons set The LEGO Group reveals the LEGO® Icons Venetian Neighbourhood (11388) set.
